title: Scene-Adaptive Nonlinear Tone Mapping for Low-Light Novel View Synthesis
description: Official code for the paper 'Scene-Adaptive Nonlinear Tone Mapping for Low-Light Novel View Synthesis' (under review at IET Image Processing, 2026). Implements percentile-normalised nonlinear tone curves (ASE and AP3) as pseudo-ground-truth generators for 3D Gaussian Splatting under low-light conditions.
